name: kilogram per hour
note: Exact conversion. The AF default UOM database may already have kg/h; if so, use it and skip this row.

name: kilopascal gauge
note: Gauge pressure kept in its own class with no conversion: converting to absolute needs the local atmospheric pressure. A site with a gauge-pressure convention should map to that.

name: thousand standard cubic meter per hour
note: Tennessee Eastman unit. Volume at standard conditions, so not convertible to actual m3/h by a fixed factor; kept in its own class with no conversion.

name: mole percent
note: Numerically equal to percent; the separate unit keeps 'mole' visible.
